entities.summary: Taiping Rebellion, a transformative movement in China (1839–1912). Emerged from Siku Quanshu — largest collection of books in Chinese history — compiled and Qianlong Emperors. Catalyzed Self-Strengthening Movement and Treaty of Nanjing — China cedes Hong Kong and opens treaty ports.
